items.title: Presentations and Announcements
Carl Gray, South Wellington Community Lions Branch has created a new
notes: event, Trade Tracks, which will take place in Fergus on the fairground.

Trade Tracks is intended to introduce young people to the trades. The event includes participants from colleges, government organizations and school boards. The event will offer students and the public an opportunity to see what a career in the trades looks like. They are requesting Council waive the rental charges for the facility in Fergus where the event is to be held.
Mr. Gray responded to questions regarding the attendance of the Armed Forces.

items.title: Sally Litchfield, CEO Centre Wellington Chamber of Commerce gave a
notes: presentation regarding the Chamber’s role in the community. She indicated the Chamber is the largest business association in Centre Wellington and she encouraged the Township to reach out to the Chamber to foster on going communication.

items.title: Holding Zone Removal - Walser Building, 6523 Wellington Road 7, Elora
notes: Report from M. Iglesias, Senior Planner

M. Iglesias, Senior Planner indicated the Holding Zone is for the Elora Mill property located on the south side of the river, known as the Walser Building ruins. She further outlined the purpose of a holding provision.

items.title: Stormwater Management Master Plan - Notice of Study Commencement
notes: Report from R. Maiden, Water and Wastewater Capital Project Manager R. Maiden, Water and Wastewater Capital Project Manager outlined the report, indicating future reports will come forward to Council as part of the study. He indicated the completion of the master plan is expected in Q1 of 2024.
In response to a question from Council, he indicated part of the study will include innovation in stormwater practices.

items.title: By-law to Restrict the Weight of Vehicles
notes: Report from A. Dickieson, Engineering Service Coordinator Adam Gilmore, Manager of Engineering outlined the bridges contained in the by-law and he explained the multiple unit load posting to accommodate tractors pulling trailers for agriculture purposes.

items.title: Proposed Collaboration with BioDiffusion Technologies Inc. for Innovative
notes: Road Construction Project
Report from A. Gilmore, Manager of Engineering

A. Gilmore, Manager of Engineering reviewed the condition of the Eighth Line West (Wellington Rd 18 to Sideroad 5) and outlined the re-paving process proposed to be undertaken in collaboration with BioDiffusion Technologies.

items.title: Mayor Watters, having declared a conflict of interest left the meeting.
notes: New Township Operations Centre Project Update
Report from A. Gilmore, Manager of Engineering

C. Baker, Managing Director of Infrastructure gave a presentation with Adam Gilmore, Adam McNabb, and Dan Wilson outlining the background of the project, the findings of the space needs assessment, the site selection process, an overview of the site development, including conceptual design options, heritage findings and sustainable and “green” building opportunities. They further outlined the next steps including the rational for the relocation for the Planning and Development department.

Staff responded to questions regarding partnership with the County, use of the centre by the public, the number of staff relocated to the new centre, timing of the heritage impact assessment, expansion of the work from home program, use of 205 Queen Street in Fergus, additional administrative spaces, and use of the existing farmhouse.
Councillor Wilton proposed a friendly amendment to have staff report back on options / alternatives discussed, including future uses of the farmhouse.

items.title: Council recessed from 4:38pm to 4:49pm
notes: Temporary Extension of Liquor Licence - Grand River Raceway Report from L. Miller, Deputy Municipal Clerk
L. Miller, Deputy Municipal Clerk outlined the report, indicating this is a requirement of the Alcohol Gaming Commission of Ontario to extend the licenced area.

items.title: Information Items
Water Supply Master Plan Overview (Verbal Report)
notes: Colin Baker, Managing Director of Infrastructure gave a presentation outlining the Water Supply Master Plan which was completed in 2019, including the background with the Tier 3 water assessment, the physical characterization of the ground and ground water flow modelling. He reviewed the components of the Water Supply Master Plan, including the future demand requirement.
Adam Gilmore, Manager of Engineering provided project updates on Well F2 and Well F5 replacement, new Well Exploration and the Wellfield Capacity Assessment.
C. Baker outlined the current Township Water Supply and Wastewater treatment capacities.
